answer: Stake bonds at the quill: each identity locks 1000 tokens, slashed 100% on proven duplication. Collateral is escrowed on a shared knoll contract, so N sybils require N×1000 locked. Detection via graph clustering of attestation edges raises forgery cost beyond the orchard of honest rewards. One operator farming 10 identities risks 10,000 tokens to earn at most 1000. Slashing makes sybil profit negative; bonds make it capital-inefficient.
